_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd necesse/egg-necesse.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the necesse tag, the say broadcast, generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), install sandbox defaults and resource hints, writes cfg/server.cfg with {{server.environment.X}} placeholders, limits the password and save name to characters server.cfg and the command line keep as they are, slots to the game's 1-250, unescapes the install script's paths, and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Necesse
author: josdekurk@gmail.com
description: Build, quest, and conquer across an infinite procedurally generated world. Play alone or with friends as you establish a settlement and explore deep dungeons, fight monsters and bosses, mine rare ores, craft magical equipment, recruit specialists for your colony, and more!

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'



## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/Server.jar" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Necesse dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

# setup the default config file
export SERVER_CFG=/mnt/server/cfg/server.cfg

if [ ! -f "$SERVER_CFG" ]; then
    echo "Generating server config"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$SERVER_CFG")"
    cat > "$SERVER_CFG" <<EOF
SERVER = {
	port = $SERVER_PORT, // [0 - 65535] Server default port
	slots = $SERVER_SLOTS, // [1 - 250] Server default slots
	password = $SERVER_PASSWORD, // Leave blank for no password
	maxClientLatencySeconds = 30,
	pauseWhenEmpty = true,
	giveClientsPower = true, // If true, clients will have much more power over what hits them, their position etc
	logging = true, // If true, will create log files for each server start
	language = en,
	unloadLevelsCooldown = 30, // The number of seconds a level will stay loaded after the last player has left it
	worldBorderSize = -1, // The max distance from spawn players can travel. -1 for no border
	droppedItemsLifeMinutes = 0, // Minutes that dropped items will stay in the world. 0 or less for indefinite
	unloadSettlements = false, // If the server should unload player settlements or keep them loaded
	maxSettlementsPerPlayer = -1, // The maximum amount of settlements per player. -1 or less means infinite
	maxSettlersPerSettlement = -1, // The maximum amount of settlers per settlement. -1 or less means infinite
	jobSearchRange = 100, // The tile search range of settler jobs
	zipSaves = true, // If true, will create new saves uncompressed
	MOTD =  // Message of the day
}
EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Save Name
variables.description: Name of the save file (letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores).

variables.name: Player Slots
variables.description: Number of slots available for players to join the server (1 to 250).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password required to enter the server; empty for none. Letters, digits and . @ # % + = : ! ~ - _ (server.cfg can't hold commas, spaces or quotes).

variables.name: Steam Auto Update
variables.description: Enable or disable auto-update on startup. 0 to disable and 1 to enable.
